tell me the status of the new firmware for this charger? When can
the customer expect it?

additional_info.subject: ID0440863-DC/Si-D/NL-[Y2/S9 313873507001] Charger charging intermittently CRM:02919000234
additional_info.body:
Hello Erik, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
If I understood correctly, what you want is the wake-up function or BCB toggle enabled in the SiD, correct?
If yes, then we have already a solution and can be applied on v6 onwards.
Starting from v8 it's as default, for now I need to install it directly on the charger.
Also, to have this working, we must have a backend connection and send this configuration:
TxStopPoint=PowerPathClosed.
If you don't have a backend please let me know as we need to see the possibilities.
This charger SN that you provided is offline so I cannot update it.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0440863-DC/Si-D/NL-[Y2/S9 313873507001] Charger charging intermittently CRM:00315002876
additional_info.body:
Hello Erik,
Thanks for the feedback.
BCB toggle is known as Wakeup function. BCB comes from how the vehicle handles the PilotState to reattempt the charging.
To apply the Wake-up hotfix, we must have v6.1.3 or newer as it has been tested on these versions. Previous to that, we are not allowed to do it.
From v8.X onwards, the hotfix is already installed by default, so we don't have to install it again in case we need it.
Regarding the
TxStopPoint=PowerPathClosed, we need to ask the OCPP backend provider to send this configuration remotely.
I will wait for your feedback next week.
Thanks and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
